test_descriptor_fixups: test that EnumDescriptor, FieldDescriptor, and ServiceDescriptor fixups correctly set containing_type and containing_service references
test_custom_options: test that GetOptions returns correct custom option extension values for file, message, field, enum, service, and method descriptors
test_copy_to_proto: test that Descriptor.CopyToProto correctly serializes message, enum, file, and service descriptors to their proto equivalents
test_make_descriptor: test that MakeDescriptor creates a Descriptor from a DescriptorProto with correct field types like CPPTYPE_UINT64
test_enum_value_name: test that Descriptor.EnumValueName returns the correct enum value name given an enum type name and number
